stability.label: Something stable
stability.description: Consistent hours, reliable income, a place I can stay.

growth.label: Room to grow
growth.description: I want to build skills and move up over time.

back_to_my_trade.label: Get back into my trade
back_to_my_trade.description: Work I already know how to do: a trade, a license, a skill I've used.

meaning.label: Work that matters to me
meaning.description: I care about what I do, not just the paycheck.

immediate.label: Something right now
immediate.description: I need income fast. I'll figure out the rest later.

independence.label: Be my own boss someday
independence.description: I want to build toward running something of my own.

community.label: Give back to my community
community.description: I've been through it. I want to help others who are going through it too.

flexibility.label: I need a flexible schedule
flexibility.description: Appointments, family, programs. My job has to work around my life.

lanes.title: Tell the story behind your work
lanes.subtitle: The work you gave us is the starting point. These answers help t.ROY decide what to lead with. Keep it short, or let him start with what you gave us.
lanes.footer: You can correct the story and every resume line before you send it.
lanes.directionError: Your direction is still on this page, but could not be saved. Try again.
lanes.guideScratch: I have the work you told me about. Tell me where you want to go and one thing I should understand. A few words are enough. I will do the writing, then you decide what stays.
lanes.guideRead: I read your page. Tell me what the page missed, then where you might want to go. A few words are enough. I will do the writing, then you decide what stays.
lanes.missedLabelScratch: What should t.ROY understand about your work?
lanes.missedLabelPage: What does your old resume miss about your work?
lanes.missedHint: Tell us about a problem you handled, work people relied on you for, or something you learned to do well. What did you do, and what happened? A short real example helps more than a list of qualities.
lanes.missedPlaceholder: I trained new people, but my resume only says I worked the line.
lanes.targetLabel: What work do you want next?
lanes.targetPlaceholder: A job title, a kind of work, or 'not sure yet'
lanes.targetHint: No target yet? Leave it blank. t.ROY will build a strong base resume from your real work.
lanes.leadTitle: Which job should t.ROY lead with?
lanes.leadHint: Pick one if it best proves your next move. Your other jobs stay on the resume.
lanes.mattersTitle: What matters most in the next job?
lanes.mattersHint: Pick any that fit. These give your story direction. The Refinery will help you judge specific jobs and work through what you cannot or do not want to do.
lanes.moreWays: More ways to describe what you want

goals.titleOpen: What could work look like for you?
goals.title: What do you actually want?
goals.subtitleOpen: Pick anything that sounds right. Nothing here is locked in.
goals.subtitle: Pick as many as fit. This changes what jobs I recommend.
goals.footer: Not sure? Pick what feels closest. We'll figure it out.
goals.whyWeAsk: This isn't a form, it's a filter. “Stability” and “growth” lead to different jobs. I need to know what matters so I don't waste your time.
goals.pickOne: Pick at least one, or describe what you're looking for below.
goals.addMore: Add more about what you want
goals.addMoreOptional: (optional). It helps, but you can skip it today.
goals.confidenceTitle: How strong is your resume right now?
goals.worriesNote: This just helps us build it right. We only ever use what's true about you.
goals.practiceTitle: Do you make art, perform, or freelance?
goals.practiceNext: Good. Your shows, performances and creative work go in your practice record. It lives in the Refinery under Creative Work, once you sign in.
goals.practiceOpen: Open it in a new tab
goals.sayMore: Want to say more about what you're looking for?
goals.narrativeLabel: Tell us more in your own words
goals.narrativePlaceholder: e.g., I want to work with my hands, or I'm interested in healthcare, or I want to start my own business someday...
goals.hookButton: What would make work feel like yours?
goals.hookLabelDemo: What would make work feel real to you?
goals.hookLabel: What would make work feel like yours?
goals.hookHint: A mentor, a mission, using your story to help others. Anything that would make getting up worth it.
goals.hookPlaceholder: e.g., I want to help people going through what I went through. Or: I want to build something I can show my kids.

preferences.title: A few quick preferences
preferences.subtitle: This helps us find the right fit. You can change any of these later.
preferences.environmentTitle: Where and how do you want to work?
preferences.environmentHint: Pick as many as fit. Skip it if you're open to anything.
preferences.confirmHint: This came from your resume. Change it if you've moved.
preferences.typeHint: Start typing a city or ZIP and pick from the list. Not listed? Type it anyway.
preferences.offerStoryBody: A record, a gap, no ride. Tell me before I build and I can look up the laws and help that fit. Or skip it and build now.

default.title: What schedule works for you?
default.shifts: Any shifts you can or can't work? Skip this if it doesn't matter.

steady.title: You want steady work. What schedule works for you?
steady.hint: Pick every one that fits. I only ask this once.
steady.shifts: Which shifts can you count on working? Skip this if it doesn't matter.

flexible.title: Your job has to fit your life. What schedule works?
flexible.hint: Pick every one that fits. I only ask this once.
flexible.shifts: Which shifts work around your appointments and family? Skip what doesn't matter.

family.title: What hours work around childcare or family care?
family.shifts: Which shifts can you cover? Skip this if it doesn't matter.

commute.title: How do you get to work, and how far can you go each day?
commute.titleTransit: How do you get around right now?
commute.hint: Pick every way you can get there.
commute.hintTransit: Pick every way you can get there. No car is fine.
commute.time: About how long can the trip be, one way?
commute.timeTransit: About how long can the trip be, one way, by bus, on foot or with a ride?

distance.further: More than an hour is fine
